verdict.rationale: Pylon's docs show AI grounded in the customer's own content: Support Agents deflect questions using your content, training data can be connected from knowledge sources to power all AI features, and the knowledge base is described as AI-integrated. Nothing in the pack shows answers citing or linking the specific article or source they drew from. missing for 10: evidence that answers show source or article citations, evidence that every answer is restricted to your own content, independent or hands-on corroboration.
